Across chart-to-code, UI-to-code, and slide-generation benchmarks (ChartMimic, Design2Code, and AeSlides), Visual-SDPO improves over the zero-shot base by more than 10 absolute points in the primary metric and over GRPO by at least 2.4 points, with fewer training steps and no added inference-time cost.

AI.tldr: 提出Visual-SDPO框架，通过视觉反馈自蒸馏和细粒度代码信用加权，提升代码生成视觉工件的质量，在图表、网页/UI和幻灯片生成任务上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 代码生成LLM生成的视觉工件（如图表、网页、幻灯片）依赖非可微渲染器，执行前即确定代码，导致视觉缺陷频发（重叠、裁剪、对齐错误、对比度低、溢出等）。现有方法缺乏对渲染后视觉反馈的有效利用来优化代码生成。
AI.method: 提出Visual-SDPO框架，包含：1）视觉反馈自蒸馏，将渲染后的视觉反馈作为特权上下文传递给学生模型；2）视觉接地代码信用加权，将检测到的缺陷追溯至对应代码语句并增强蒸馏信号；3）序列级GRPO奖励可执行且视觉高质量的输出，同时通过自蒸馏路径处理执行失败样本。
AI.result: 在ChartMimic、Design2Code、AeSlides三个基准上，Visual-SDPO相比零样本基线提升超10个绝对百分点，相比GRPO提升至少2.4个百分点，且训练步数更少、无推理额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 通过将渲染后的视觉反馈以自蒸馏方式融入代码生成LLM的训练，并引入细粒度的缺陷-代码对应加权机制，能有效提升视觉工件生成的代码质量，方法高效且通用。

title: FoA-SR: Faithful or Aesthetic? Profile-Aware Preference Optimization for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
summary: Real-world image super-resolution (SR) is often designed with a single restoration objective, despite the current capacity of generative models to produce multiple high-quality reconstructions for the same input. In this paper, we argue that the best restoration strategy is subject to the specific restoration profile: a Faithful restoration prioritizes reference consistency, structure preservation, and hallucination suppression, whereas an Aesthetic restoration prioritizes visually pleasing and natural-looking details. We propose FoA-SR, a novel preference optimization approach to real-world SR based on profiles. To achieve this goal, FoA-SR starts with our supervised FLUX.2-based SR adapter (Flux2SR) trained with LR latent conditioning, flow matching, and image-space reconstruction losses for paired LR-to-HR image super-resolution. Following the development of the shared supervised super-resolution adapter, FoA-SR generates a shared stochastic candidate pool for each input image and ranks the same candidates using profile-specific Faithful and Aesthetic rewards to mine winner-loser pairs. These pairs are used to fine-tune separate LoRA adapters while keeping the base model frozen. Experiments on RealSR and DIV2K show that FoA-SR can steer the same SR adapter towards distinct restoration objectives: a Faithful adapter improves reference-consistent metrics while an Aesthetic adapter boosts metrics that measure perceptual quality without reference. Our candidate-pool analysis shows that Faithful and Aesthetic rewards frequently select different winners, and a Hybrid-LoRA ablation shows that collapsing both profiles into one reward yields an implicit compromise rather than explicit profile control.

AI.tldr: 提出FoA-SR方法，通过偏好优化和LoRA微调，将同一个超分模型导向“忠实”或“美学”两种不同重建偏好，实现显式的轮廓控制。
AI.motivation: 真实图像超分通常只设计单一重建目标，但生成模型可以为同一输入产生多种高质量重建，不同场景需要不同偏好（忠实vs美学），现有方法缺乏显式的轮廓控制。
AI.method: 1) 基于FLUX.2训练共享的监督超分适配器Flux2SR；2) 为每张输入生成共享的随机候选池；3) 使用忠实奖励和美学奖励分别排序候选，挖掘胜者-败者对；4) 用这些对微调分离的LoRA适配器，保持基模型冻结。
AI.result: 在RealSR和DIV2K上，忠实适配器提升参考一致性指标，美学适配器提升无参考感知质量指标；候选池分析显示两种奖励常选择不同胜者。
AI.conclusion: FoA-SR能将同一个SR适配器导向不同重建目标，实现显式轮廓控制，而混合两种奖励只会产生隐式折中。

title: TabClaw: An Interactive and Self-Evolving Agent for Spreadsheet Manipulation and Table Reasoning
summary: Spreadsheets and tables are widely used representations for structured data analysis, but effective analysis still requires substantial manual effort and domain expertise. Recent large language model (LLM) agents can automate parts of this process, but they often provide limited transparency into intermediate decisions, rely on implicit assumptions, struggle with multi-table comparison, and repeat similar workflows without adapting to a user's preferences. This paper presents TabClaw, an open-source interactive AI agent for spreadsheet manipulation and table reasoning. Users upload CSV or Excel files and issue natural-language requests; TabClaw clarifies ambiguous intent, exposes an editable execution plan, streams a ReAct-style tool-using analysis loop, dispatches specialist agents for parallel multi-table reasoning, and synthesizes findings with explicit consensus and uncertainty markers. Beyond one-off analysis, TabClaw records completed workflows, extracts persistent user memory, distills reusable skills from repeated tool-use patterns, supports package-style skill import, and upgrades skills from negative feedback. Experiments on spreadsheet manipulation and table reasoning benchmarks show that TabClaw improves executable task completion and reasoning performance while preserving an inspectable user workflow. This paper shows how TabClaw turns spreadsheets and tables into inspectable analytical workflows while gradually personalizing itself to recurring data-analysis tasks. Our code is available.

AI.tldr: TabClaw是一个开源的交互式AI代理，用于电子表格操作和表格推理，能够通过澄清意图、展示可编辑执行计划、流式分析循环、并行多表推理以及记录工作流和用户记忆等功能，将电子表格和表格转化为可检查的分析工作流，并逐步个性化适应重复的数据分析任务。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的代理在结构化数据分析中存在透明度有限、依赖隐式假设、难以处理多表比较、无法适应用户偏好等问题，需要一种更可检查且能个性化适应的解决方案。
AI.method: TabClaw采用ReAct风格的工具使用分析循环，支持澄清模糊意图、暴露可编辑执行计划、流式显示分析过程、调度专用代理进行并行多表推理，并记录完成的工作流、提取持久用户记忆、从重复工具使用模式中提炼可复用技能。
AI.result: 在电子表格操作和表格推理基准测试上，TabClaw在可执行任务完成和推理性能方面均有提升，同时保持了可检查的用户工作流。
AI.conclusion: TabClaw将电子表格和表格转化为可检查的分析工作流，并能逐步个性化适应重复的数据分析任务，代码已开源。

title: Reasoning or Memorization? Direction-Aware Diversity Exploration in LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning has become a key paradigm for eliciting reasoning abilities in large language models, where exploration is crucial for discovering effective solution trajectories. Existing exploration methods typically encourage diversity in semantic or gradient spaces, without distinguishing what drives this diversity. A trajectory may appear novel because it follows a new reasoning process, or because it varies memorized patterns and shortcuts. Rewarding both cases equally may steer exploration toward memorization rather than genuine reasoning improvement. In this paper, we propose DiRL, a Direction-Aware Reinforcement Learning framework that anchors exploration to an internal reasoning-memorization direction of the policy. Specifically, DiRL extracts this direction from model representations, constructs direction-weighted gradient features to characterize rollout updates, and shapes rewards to amplify reasoning-aligned exploration while suppressing memorization-aligned variations. DiRL integrates seamlessly into standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Extensive experiments on mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of DiRL, showing significant improvements over various existing exploration methods.

AI.tldr: 提出DiRL框架，通过识别和区分推理与记忆方向，引导强化学习中的探索朝向真正的推理改进，抑制记忆模式变化。
AI.motivation: 现有探索方法鼓励语义或梯度空间的多样性，但无法区分新颖轨迹是源于新的推理过程还是记忆模式的变体，导致探索偏向记忆而非真正的推理提升。
AI.method: 从模型表征中提取内在的推理-记忆方向，构建方向加权的梯度特征来描述轨迹更新，并设计奖励函数以放大推理对齐的探索、抑制记忆对齐的变异。该方法可无缝集成到GRPO中。
AI.result: 在数学和通用推理基准上，DiRL显著优于多种现有探索方法。
AI.conclusion: DiRL通过方向感知的探索策略，有效引导大语言模型在强化学习中朝向真正的推理能力提升，避免陷入记忆模式的表面多样性。

title: Dissect and Prune: Enhancing Robustness in AI-Generated Image Detection
comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, 9 tables, Accepted to ICML 2026; includes appendix
summary: While existing AI-generated image detectors report high performance, we identify that this is largely driven by a critical prediction asymmetry: a bias toward the real class that severely limits sensitivity to generated content, especially under standard post-processing operations such as compression and resizing. We hypothesize that this stems from the model's reliance on spurious features, distracting signals that obscure true generative artifacts. To address this, we propose DEAR (Dissect and Prune), which leverages inpainted images to identify and prune these interfering components. Specifically, we find that features strongly aligned to either inpainted or non-inpainted regions are less robust to post-processing. By measuring the alignment between channel activations and inpaint masks, DEAR removes features at both extremes, retaining only those that capture genuine generative artifacts. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances robustness against unseen generators and post-processing, effectively mitigating the prediction asymmetry. Our code is available at https://github.com/dahyedahye/dear.

AI.tldr: 现有AI生成图像检测器存在严重的预测不对称性（偏向真实类），作者提出DEAR方法，通过分析图像修复区域的特征对齐度来剪除干扰特征，从而提升检测器对未知生成器和后处理的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器虽然报告高性能，但实际存在严重的预测不对称性——模型偏向真实类，导致对生成内容的敏感度不足，尤其在压缩、缩放等后处理操作下表现更差。作者认为这是由于模型依赖了虚假特征（spurious features）所致。
AI.method: 提出DEAR（Dissect and Prune）方法：利用修复图像（inpainted images）来识别并剪除干扰特征。通过测量通道激活与修复掩模之间的对齐程度，移除两端极端对齐的特征，只保留那些能捕捉真实生成伪影的特征。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，DEAR显著增强了对未知生成器和后处理的鲁棒性，有效缓解了预测不对称性问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过剪除与修复区域极端对齐的特征，DEAR能够提升AI生成图像检测器在更实际场景下的泛化能力和鲁棒性。

title: ReflectiChain: Epistemic Grounding in LLM-Driven World Models for Supply Chain Resilience
summary: AI agents in supply chains face a fundamental epistemic gap: large language models (LLMs) interpret policies but lack physical grounding, while reinforcement learning (RL) optimizes flows but is semantically blind to unstructured constraints. We introduce REFLECTICHAIN, bridging this gap through a Generative Supply Chain World Model (SC-WM) - encoding heterogeneous supply networks into a 6-dim graph-latent space with physical conservation - and Double-Loop Learning that separates epistemic uncertainty (KL-trust-region-bounded policy adaptation) from aleatoric uncertainty (stochastic latent rollouts). On Semi-Sim, a 10-node semiconductor benchmark with SIR risk propagation, 6 perturbation types, and 10 policy constraint templates, REFLECTICHAIN improves Rationale Consistency Score by 33.0% (p < 0.0001, d = 2.78), maintains 82.3% operability under adversarial shocks, and exhibits anti-fragile behavior (+40.2% gain under moderate pressure). We identify three operational epistemic mechanisms - uncertainty separation, knowledge-boundary detection, and empirical Bayesian policy updating - and discuss five limitation categories.

AI.tldr: REFLECTICHAIN通过生成式供应链世界模型（SC-WM）和双环学习框架，弥合了LLM策略理解与RL优化之间的认知鸿沟，在半导体基准测试中实现了33.0%的合理性提升和抗脆弱行为。
AI.motivation: AI智能体在供应链中面临根本性认知鸿沟：LLM能解释策略但缺乏物理基础，RL能优化流程但对非结构化约束语义盲视，亟需一种桥接两者的方法。
AI.method: 提出REFLECTICHAIN框架，包含：(1) 生成式供应链世界模型（SC-WM），将异构供应网络编码为6维图-潜空间并保持物理守恒；(2) 双环学习，将认知不确定性（KL信任域约束的策略适应）与偶发不确定性（随机潜空间推演）分离。
AI.result: 在10节点半导体基准Semi-Sim上，合理性一致性评分提升33.0%（p<0.0001，d=2.78），对抗冲击下维持82.3%可操作性，并在中等压力下表现出抗脆弱行为（+40.2%增益）。
AI.conclusion: 识别出三种操作性认知机制（不确定性分离、知识边界检测、经验贝叶斯策略更新），并讨论了五类局限性。

title: Content-Induced Spatial-Spectral Aggregation Network for Change Detection in Remote Sensing Images
summary: The integration of spatial and spectral information is beneficial to the improvement of change detection performance. However, existing methods cannot efficiently suppress the influences of spatial and spectral differences in unchanged areas. To address these issues, in this paper we propose a content-guided spatial-spectral integration network (CSI-Net) for the fusion of global spatial details and spectral difference information. Specifically, the proposed CSI-Net is composed of a spatial reasoning (SR) module, a spectral difference (SD) module, and a content-guided integration (CGI) module. In the SR module, the spatial information is learned by cascaded graph convolution blocks for global modeling. The SD module is responsible for the extraction of spectral features, by calculating the means and variances of features to reduce the impact of spectral differences in unchanged regions. In addition, in order to integrate the spatial-spectral features efficiently, we design a CGI module to further take advantage of their complementary information. In this module, high-level content information is introduced as a guide for a proper interaction. Due to the efficient spatial-spectral fusion, the proposed CSI-Net can learn the changed features better while achieving a suppression of spectral differences. Experimental results on LEVIR-CD, WHU-CD, and CLCD datasets demonstrate that the proposed CSI-Net produces better performance compared to state-of-the-art methods, and is applicable to different scenarios

AI.tldr: 提出一种内容引导的空间-光谱融合网络(CSI-Net)，通过空间推理、光谱差异和内容引导融合三个模块，有效抑制未变化区域的空间和光谱差异，在三个公开数据集上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有变化检测方法无法有效抑制未变化区域中空间和光谱差异的影响，导致检测性能受限。
AI.method: 提出CSI-Net，包含三个核心模块：1) 空间推理(SR)模块：使用级联图卷积块学习全局空间信息；2) 光谱差异(SD)模块：通过计算特征的均值和方差来减少未变化区域的光谱差异影响；3) 内容引导融合(CGI)模块：引入高层内容信息作为引导，实现空间-光谱特征的高效互补融合。
AI.result: 在LEVIR-CD、WHU-CD和CLCD三个数据集上，所提CSI-Net均优于现有最先进方法，适用于不同场景。
AI.conclusion: 高效的时空光谱融合使得CSI-Net能够更好地学习变化特征，同时有效抑制光谱差异，具有较好的泛化能力。

title: Routing-Aware Expert Calibration for Machine Unlearning in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
summary: Machine unlearning is increasingly important for large language models, yet unlearning in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures remains underexplored. Unlike dense models, MoE architectures employ a router at each layer to assign each token to a sparse subset of experts. In this work, we observe that forget data often activates a small subset of experts disproportionately, while these experts may receive much weaker activation from retain data. This forget--retain routing mismatch can leave forget-critical experts under-regularized during unlearning. To address this, we propose \textbf{TRACE}, Targeted Routing-Aware Calibration of Experts, for MoE unlearning. TRACE first detects forget-critical experts from offline activation statistics, and then calibrates retain regularization by reweighting token-level retain losses so that each selected expert's retain-side activation frequency better matches its forget-side counterpart. Experiments on WMDP and MUSE-BOOKS across multiple MoE LLMs show that TRACE consistently improves the forget-utility trade-off, yielding a 9\% relative utility improvement over the strongest baseline under comparable forgetting quality and the best performance on three out of four MUSE-BOOKS metrics.

AI.tldr: 针对MoE架构大模型中的机器遗忘问题，提出TRACE方法，通过检测遗忘关键专家并校准保留正则化，有效改善遗忘-效用权衡。
AI.motivation: MoE架构中遗忘数据与保留数据对专家激活存在不匹配（routing mismatch），导致遗忘关键专家在遗忘过程中正则化不足，影响遗忘效果与模型效用之间的平衡。
AI.method: TRACE方法：首先通过离线激活统计检测遗忘关键专家，然后通过重新加权token级保留损失来校准保留正则化，使每个选中专家的保留侧激活频率与遗忘侧相匹配。
AI.result: 在WMDP和MUSE-BOOKS数据集上，TRACE在多个MoE大模型中一致改善了遗忘-效用权衡，在可比遗忘质量下相对最强基线提升9%的效用，并在MUSE-BOOKS四项指标中三项取得最佳。
AI.conclusion: TRACE方法有效解决了MoE架构中遗忘数据与保留数据路由不匹配导致的遗忘关键专家正则化不足问题，在遗忘效果和模型效用之间取得了更好的平衡。

title: Building Change Detection in Earthquake: A Multi-Scale Interaction Network and A Change Detection Dataset
summary: As one of the most destructive natural disasters, earthquakes have struck many countries around the world in recent years, causing serious economic losses. Change detection (CD) can be applied to post-earthquake damage assessment as it can infer destroyed change regions from multi-temporal remote sensing images. Furthermore, the CD with short imaging interval will better satisfy the needs of the emergency rescues after earthquakes. However, the capability of current methods built on deep neural networks is limited because the dataset with short imaging interval is absent. To meet post-disaster immediate relief, we create a CD dataset, Turkey earthquake CD dataset (TUE-CD), for the evaluation of building damage in the short term after an earthquake. Because of the short acquisition interval of the post-event images, the imaging angle is different for different temporal images, which leads to some side-looking problems. To deal with these challenges, we present a multi-scale feature interaction network (MSI-Net) for efficient interaction between bi-temporal features, as well as mitigating the effect of side-looking problems. Specifically, the proposed MSI-Net consists of joint cross-attention (JCA) modules, multi-scale offset calibration (MOC) modules, and feature integration (FeI) modules. The JCA module unifies channel cross-attention and spatial joint attention for sufficient feature interaction. The MOC module further estimates the offsets to align the bi-temporal image with the multi-scale features. Finally, calibrated features and multi-scale features are fused by FeI modules for the prediction of changed areas. Experiments on the WHU-CD, CLCD, and the constructed TUE-CD dataset indicate that the proposed MSI-Net provides better results than considered state-of-the-art CD methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对震后短期建筑物损害评估缺乏短间隔成像数据集的问题，构建了土耳其地震变化检测数据集（TUE-CD），并提出了多尺度特征交互网络（MSI-Net），通过联合交叉注意力、多尺度偏移校准和特征集成模块，有效缓解了因成像角度差异导致的侧视问题，在多个数据集上取得了优于现有方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 地震造成严重经济损失，变化检测可应用于震后损害评估；短成像间隔的变化检测更能满足震后应急需求，但当前基于深度神经网络的方法因缺乏短间隔成像数据集而能力受限。
AI.method: 提出多尺度特征交互网络（MSI-Net），包含联合交叉注意力（JCA）模块、多尺度偏移校准（MOC）模块和特征集成（FeI）模块；JCA统一通道交叉注意力和空间联合注意力实现特征交互，MOC估计偏移量对齐双时相图像的多尺度特征，FeI融合校准特征与多尺度特征进行变化区域预测。
AI.result: 在WHU-CD、CLCD和自主构建的TUE-CD数据集上，所提MSI-Net优于现有主流变化检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 构建了TUE-CD数据集弥补短间隔成像数据缺失，提出的MSI-Net有效解决了成像角度差异导致的侧视问题，提升了震后建筑物损害评估的性能。

title: PADD: Path-Aligned Decompression Distillation for Non-Router Teacher to Guide MoE Student Learning
summary: As large language models (LLMs) continue to scale, it becomes increasingly challenging to grow model capacity under fixed computation budgets. We propose Path-Aligned Decompression Distillation (PADD), a framework for distilling knowledge from dense teachers without explicit routing into mixture-of-experts (MoE) students while learning high-quality routing policies. PADD organizes knowledge distillation into four stages in two phases: an initialization phase (Stage I) that builds diverse functionality in the student's experts through teacher neuron clustering and student-expert warmup, and a training phase (Stages II--IV) that integrates online adaptive distillation, path-refined policy optimization, and reward-augmented load balancing in a single training pipeline. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PADD yields substantial gains over strong baselines at the same inference cost and that the MoE student can match or surpass its dense teacher. They also demonstrate effective teacher-to-student knowledge distillation and stable routing behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为PADD的框架，用于从密集教师模型向混合专家（MoE）学生模型进行知识蒸馏，同时学习高质量的路由策略，分两阶段四阶段进行，在数学推理任务上取得了显著效果。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型规模不断扩大，在固定计算预算下增长模型容量变得越来越具有挑战性，因此需要一种有效的知识蒸馏方法来将密集模型的知识转移到MoE模型中。
AI.method: PADD框架包含初始化阶段（教师神经元聚类和学生专家预热）和训练阶段（在线自适应蒸馏、路径优化策略和奖励增强的负载均衡）两阶段四阶段流程。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准测试中，PADD在相同推理成本下显著优于强基线方法，MoE学生模型能够匹配甚至超越其密集教师模型，且展示了有效的知识蒸馏和稳定的路由行为。
AI.conclusion: PADD框架能够有效地从密集教师模型向MoE学生模型进行知识蒸馏，在保持推理成本不变的情况下提升模型性能，实现高效的容量扩展。

title: Beyond Static Evaluation: Co-Evolutionary Mechanisms for LLM-Driven Strategy Evolution in Adversarial Games
summary: Recent advances in LLM-driven code evolution have enabled automated discovery by iteratively generating and improving programs. However, applying these methods to adversarial multi-agent games introduces a fundamental challenge: the evaluation landscape shifts as strategies improve, causing fixed evaluators to become unreliable and evolution to stagnate. We propose three mechanisms to address this challenge: evaluator co-evolution, which incorporates discovered champions into the opponent pool; hierarchical deep evaluation, which replaces noisy few-game scores with statistically reliable assessments; and weakness pressure, which dynamically up-weights the most difficult opponents to break through plateaus. We implement these mechanisms within FAMOU, a framework built upon the same foundation-model code-evolution paradigm as OpenEvolve and ShinkaEvolve. On the MCTF 2026 3v3 maritime capture-the-flag task, FAMOU consistently outperforms both baselines under two backbone LLMs, achieving the highest combined score (0.526) and the best generalization to unseen opponents (61.7% win rate), while ablations confirm that each mechanism contributes to performance. Notably, the LLM mutation process generates tactical structures entirely absent from the seed strategies -- including lookahead search and adaptive interception -- demonstrating that code-level evolution can produce nontrivial algorithmic innovations in adversarial settings. The FAMOU-evolved strategy further achieved 1st place in the hardware round-robin and 3rd in simulation at the AAMAS 2026 MCTF Competition, validating its real-world transferability. The optimized implementation and corresponding evaluation codes developed through our evolutionary process are available at: https://github.com/1xiangliu1/FAMOU-CoEvo

AI.tldr: 提出FAMOU框架，通过评估器共进化、分层深度评估和弱点压力三种机制，解决LLM驱动代码进化在多智能体对抗游戏中的评估漂移问题，在MCTF 2026任务中取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的代码进化在对抗性多智能体游戏中面临评估景观随策略提升而漂移的问题，固定评估器变得不可靠，导致进化停滞。
AI.method: 提出三种机制：1) 评估器共进化——将发现的冠军策略纳入对手池；2) 分层深度评估——用统计可靠评估替代噪声大的少局评分；3) 弱点压力——动态加权最难对手以突破平台期。
AI.result: 在MCTF 2026 3v3任务中，FAMOU取得最高综合得分(0.526)和最好泛化性能(61.7%胜率)，消融实验验证各机制有效性；LLM变异生成了前瞻搜索和自适应拦截等全新战术结构；在AAMAS 2026竞赛中获得硬件循环赛第1名和仿真第3名。
AI.conclusion: 代码级进化能够在对抗性设定中产生非平凡的算法创新，且FAMOU策略具有良好的真实世界可迁移性。

title: Multi-Angular Reflectance Anisotropy Observed from UAV Multispectral Imagery
summary: UAV multispectral imagery naturally contains multi-angular observations due to low flight altitude and wide field-of-view imaging, which may introduce geometry-driven radiometric variability. This study proposes a geometry-aware multi-angular observation extraction workflow to quantify observation-geometry effects from a BRDF perspective. Specifically, camera intrinsics and extrinsics are refined via structure-from-motion (SFM), and homogeneous regions annotated on an orthomosaic are reprojected onto multiple raw sub-images acquired from different viewpoints. This enables joint extraction of multi-band reflectance and observation geometry parameters for the same ground targets under varying viewing directions. The extracted observations are further analyzed using band-wise polar visualization in the (VZA, RAA) domain. Results on a grassland target show clear reflectance anisotropy across ten bands, with red-edge and nearinfrared bands exhibiting 119-137% variability between maximum and minimum reflectance, indicating non-negligible observation-geometry effects on radiometric consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种几何感知的多角度观测提取流程，从BRDF视角量化无人机多光谱影像中的观测几何效应。通过SFM精化相机参数，将正射 mosaic 上的同质区域反投影到多张原始子图像，联合提取多波段反射率和观测几何参数。实验表明红边和近红外波段反射率变异高达119-137%，观测几何效应不可忽略。
AI.motivation: 无人机多光谱影像因低空飞行和宽视场成像而天然包含多角度观测，可能引入几何驱动的辐射变异性，需要量化观测几何对辐射一致性的影响。
AI.method: 通过SFM精化相机内参和外参，在正射影像上标注同质区域并反投影到多个不同视角的原始子图像，联合提取多波段反射率和观测几何参数，并在(VZA, RAA)域进行分波段极坐标可视化分析。
AI.result: 草地目标的十个波段均表现出明显的反射率各向异性，红边和近红外波段的最大-最小反射率变异性高达119-137%。
AI.conclusion: 无人机多光谱影像中观测几何效应显著，对辐射一致性有不可忽略的影响，需在后续分析中加以考虑。

title: Instruction Finetuning DeepSeek-R1-8B Model Using LoRA and NEFTune
summary: Financial named-entity recognition (NER) is essential for translating unstructured financial reports and news into structured knowledge graphs. However, general-purpose large language models (LLMs) often misclassify financial entities or ignore domain-specific patterns. This paper investigates the use of DeepSeek-R1-8B, a recent open-source large language model, combined with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and Noisy Embedding Fine-Tuning (NEFTune) for financial NER. Each annotated sentence in our corpus of 1693 samples is converted into an instruction-input-output triple. We insert lightweight LoRA matrices into the Transformer layers and apply NEFTune to improve generalisation by adding uniform noise to embedding vectors during training. Experiments show that the LoRA-adapted DeepSeek-R1-8B achieves a micro-F1 of 0.901 on seven entity types (Company, Date, Location, Money, Person, Product and Quantity), and adding NEFTune further boosts the micro-F1 to 0.912, outperforming Llama3-8B, Qwen3-8B, Baichuan2-7B, T5 and BERT-Base baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文使用DeepSeek-R1-8B结合LoRA和NEFTune进行金融命名实体识别，在1693样本数据集上达到0.912的micro-F1，优于多个基线模型。
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型在处理金融实体时容易误分类或忽略领域特定模式，需要专门针对金融NER的优化方法。
AI.method: 将每条标注句子转化为指令-输入-输出三元组，在Transformer层插入LoRA矩阵，并引入NEFTune（在训练时向嵌入向量添加均匀噪声）以提升泛化能力。
AI.result: LoRA适配的DeepSeek-R1-8B达到0.901 micro-F1，加入NEFTune后提升至0.912，优于Llama3-8B、Qwen3-8B等基线。
AI.conclusion: 结合LoRA和NEFTune的DeepSeek-R1-8B能有效提升金融NER性能，验证了轻量化微调方法在金融领域实体识别中的有效性。

title: Benchmarking stereo reconstruction for 3D printable Martian terrain models
summary: Reconstructing printable 3D models from Mars rover imagery is challenging because Martian terrain is low-texture, irregular, and partially observed. We evaluate a pipeline that estimates stereo depth from NASA Curiosity images, completes geometry, and exports watertight OBJ meshes. On Middlebury, RAFT-Stereo outperforms semi-global block matching (SGBM), reducing disparity MAE from 3.22px to 0.73px and increasing valid prediction coverage from 76.3% to 100.0%. On Curiosity imagery, however, RAFT's denser disparities show weaker edge alignment and higher photometric reprojection error, suggesting that benchmark accuracy does not directly transfer to Martian terrain reconstruction. Geometry completion demonstrates a tradeoff between local fidelity and global connectivity. We find that alpha shapes preserve accurate but fragmented structure, Poisson reconstruction produces more coherent meshes but adds unsupported surfaces, and a deterministic diffusion-fill baseline is intermediate but sensitive to stereo quality. Overall, standard stereo and completion methods can produce printable approximations of Martian terrain, but reliable reconstruction requires stronger domain-specific validation.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了从火星车图像重建可打印3D模型的流程，发现在标准基准上表现优异的RAFT-Stereo在火星地形上反而弱于传统SGBM方法，且不同几何补全方法存在保真度与连通性的权衡，最终指出需要领域特定的验证标准。
AI.motivation: 火星地形具有低纹理、不规则、部分观测等特性，使得从火星车图像重建可打印3D模型面临挑战，现有方法缺乏针对火星地形的系统评估。
AI.method: 使用NASA好奇号火星车立体图像，对比RAFT-Stereo与SGBM的立体匹配性能；采用alpha shapes、Poisson重建和扩散填充三种几何补全方法生成水密OBJ网格。
AI.result: 在Middlebury基准上RAFT-Stereo优于SGBM（MAE 0.73px vs 3.22px），但在好奇号图像上RAFT的边缘对齐更差、重投影误差更高。alpha shapes保留精确但碎片化结构，Poisson重建生成连贯但引入虚假表面，扩散填充介于两者之间但受立体匹配质量影响。
AI.conclusion: 标准立体匹配和几何补全方法能生成可打印的火星地形近似模型，但基准测试的准确性不能直接迁移到火星场景，可靠重建需要更强的领域特定验证。

title: Do Vision-Language Models See or Guess? Measuring and Reducing Textual-Prior Reliance with a Phrasing-Controlled Benchmark
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed where answers must follow from what is in the image, yet they often answer from textual priors, the question's phrasing together with memorized world knowledge, rather than from the image itself, which inflates benchmark scores and yields confident but ungrounded answers. Existing benchmarks rarely isolate this behavior, since each image is usually paired with a single fixed question. To measure the reliance, we build a 540-image benchmark across six reasoning categories and generate four question variants over the same images, so that phrasing rather than image content is the controlled variable. The hardest variant is written directly from the image to minimize text leakage. We benchmark eleven VLMs spanning small open-weight models to large closed-source systems: every model degrades on the hardest variant, and open models fall furthest. Our central diagnostic is a no-image ablation, which collapses the open-weight models to their text-only floor (1 to 9 percent). Three further analyses, LLM-rated difficulty, low base-to-final textual similarity, and human re-annotation, corroborate genuine image-dependence. In-context exemplars that match how a variant was built recover the most accuracy, and GRPO post-training of a small VLM yields consistent gains across all four variants that transfer to a held-out out-of-distribution set. Textual-prior reliance is measurable and partly trainable away.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个540张图片、六类推理的基准测试，通过为同一图像生成四种问题变体（最难的变体直接从图像编写以减少文本泄露），评估了11个视觉语言模型对文本先验（而非图像内容）的依赖程度。研究发现所有模型在最难变体上性能下降，去除图像后开源模型准确率骤降至1-9%，而GRPO后训练能部分缓解这一问题。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型常依赖文本先验（即问题措辞和记忆的世界知识）而非图像本身来回答，这虚高了基准分数，但现有基准因每张图像通常只配单一固定问题而难以隔离这种依赖行为。本文旨在系统测量并诊断这一现象。
AI.method: 构建540张图像的基准，覆盖六类推理，为每张图像生成四种问题变体（最难的变体直接从图像编写以最小化文本泄漏），评估11个VLM（从开源小模型到闭源大系统），并设计了无图像消融实验、LLM难度评分、文本相似度分析、人工重标注等诊断手段。
AI.result: 所有模型在最难变体上性能均下降，开源模型下降最严重；无图像消融使开源模型准确率降至1-9%；上下文示例和GRPO后训练能部分恢复准确率。
AI.conclusion: 文本先验依赖是可测量且可部分通过训练消除的。

title: STAGE-Claw: Automated State-based Agent Benchmarking for Realistic Scenarios
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to power personal agents for everyday applications, but evaluating these agents remains a challenge. Existing benchmarks still rely on sandboxed artifacts, static task design, and coarse scoring, which hinder scalability and limit progress toward reliable personal-agent evaluation. This paper introduces STAGE-Claw, an automated framework for building and evaluating realistic personal-agent scenarios in state-based personal-computing environments. Given a task hint, STAGE-Claw automatically creates and validates a realistic benchmark task with its environment, task prompts, ground truth, and related verification programs. Agents are then evaluated in realistic operating environments, where performance is measured by the correctness of the final system state rather than only the textual response. Using STAGE-Claw, this paper creates a benchmark with 40 challenging real scenario agent tasks, evaluates 11 frontier models, and analyzes their task scores, costs, tool-call reliability, and common failure patterns. Overall, STAGE-Claw offers a scalable, state-based way to evaluate agents in realistic user scenarios.

AI.tldr: STAGE-Claw是一个自动化框架，用于在基于状态的个人计算环境中构建和评估真实个人场景的AI代理，通过40个任务评估了11个前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 现有代理评估依赖沙盒环境、静态任务设计和粗粒度评分，限制了可扩展性和可靠评估的发展。
AI.method: STAGE-Claw根据任务提示自动创建并验证基准任务，包括环境、提示、真实标签和验证程序；代理在真实操作环境中评估，性能由最终系统状态正确性衡量。
AI.result: 创建了包含40个真实场景任务的基准，评估了11个前沿模型，分析了任务得分、成本、工具调用可靠性和常见失败模式。
AI.conclusion: STAGE-Claw提供了一种可扩展的、基于状态的方式，用于在真实用户场景中评估代理。

title: Harnessing the Collective Intelligence of AI Agents in the Wild for New Discoveries
summary: Scientific discovery is often a collective process: researchers share partial results, inspect failed attempts, and build on each other's ideas over long time horizons. Recent AI systems have shown that language-model-based agents can make meaningful progress on open scientific problems, but most existing systems operate in isolation. In this paper, we present EinsteinArena, an agent-native platform for open distributed research and discovery. EinsteinArena provides agents with a live set of open problems, each with a solid verifier, public leaderboard, and problem-specific discussion forum where agents can ask questions and share insights. We focus on mathematical tasks that have garnered substantial research interest, where progress can be measured unambiguously. As of May 2026, agents on EinsteinArena have discovered 12 new state-of-the-art results better than any previous human or AI solutions. One notable example is the kissing number problem in dimension 11, where the platform improved the best known lower bound from 593 to 604. This advance did not come from a single agent or isolated run. Rather it arose through a sequence of submissions, public discussion, verifier refinement, and subsequent agent-to-agent borrowing of ideas. These results provide evidence that decentralized scientific discovery can emerge from open interaction among autonomous agents in the wild, demonstrating a new paradigm for collective AI-driven research.

AI.tldr: EinsteinArena是一个基于智能体的开放科研平台，智能体可以共享部分结果、讨论失败尝试并相互借鉴。截至2026年5月，该平台已发现12个新SOTA结果，如将11维接吻数问题下界从593提升至604。
AI.motivation: 现有AI科研系统多独立运行，缺乏集体协作与长时间跨度的知识积累，而科学发现本质上是一个集体过程。
AI.method: 构建EinsteinArena平台，提供开放问题集、可验证器、公开排行榜和讨论论坛，让多个智能体自主交流、共享见解并迭代改进。
AI.result: 平台上智能体已发现12个新的SOTA数学结果；11维接吻数问题下界从593提升至604，该进步源于多轮提交、公开讨论和智能体间思想借鉴。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化的科学发现可以从自主智能体的开放交互中涌现，为集体AI驱动的研究提供了新范式。

title: A Unified Multi-Modal Framework for Intelligent Financial Systems: Integrating Reinforcement Learning, High-Frequency Trading, and Game-Theoretic Approaches with Cross-Modal Sentiment Analysis
summary: The rapid evolution of financial technology demands sophisticated artificial intelligence systems capable of handling diverse challenges across multiple domains simultaneously. This paper presents a groundbreaking unified framework that seamlessly integrates Proximal Policy Optimization for robo-advisory systems, advanced time-series prediction models for high-frequency trading, in-context learning mechanisms for dynamic investment advisory, game-theoretic approaches for competitive banking scenarios, and unified embeddings for cross-modal financial sentiment analysis. Our comprehensive framework addresses the critical gap in existing literature where these technologies have been developed in isolation, failing to leverage their synergistic potential. Through extensive experimentation across multiple financial datasets and real-world scenarios, we demonstrate that our integrated approach achieves superior performance compared to specialized single-domain systems. Specifically, our framework shows a 23.7% improvement in portfolio optimization metrics, reduces prediction error in high-frequency trading by 31.2%, enhances investment recommendation accuracy by 18.9%, optimizes competitive banking strategies with a 27.4% increase in Nash equilibrium convergence speed, and improves sentiment analysis accuracy by 15.6% through cross-modal fusion. The theoretical foundation of our work establishes convergence guarantees for the integrated optimization problem, while our empirical results validate the practical applicability across diverse financial institutions. This research not only advances the state-of-the-art in financial AI but also provides a blueprint for developing comprehensive intelligent systems that can adapt to the complex, interconnected nature of modern financial markets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，整合了PPO、时序预测、上下文学习、博弈论和跨模态嵌入等多种AI技术，在多个金融领域任务中均显著优于单一领域系统。
AI.motivation: 现有金融AI技术孤立发展，未能发挥协同潜力，缺乏统一的综合框架来应对多领域的复合挑战。
AI.method: 将PPO、时间序列预测、上下文学习、博弈论方法和跨模态嵌入统一集成到一个框架中，并通过多数据集和真实场景进行实验验证。
AI.result: 投资组合优化提升23.7%，高频交易预测误差降低31.2%，投资推荐准确率提高18.9%，银行竞争策略纳什均衡收敛速度提升27.4%，情感分析准确率提升15.6%。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架在理论和实践上均证明了综合金融AI系统的有效性，为复杂金融市场提供了可适应的智能系统蓝图。

title: PF-Trans: Physics-Embedded Frequency-Aware Transformer for Spectral Reconstruction
summary: Snapshot Broadband Filter Array (BFA) imaging provides high light throughput for spectral reconstruction but introduces severe spectral aliasing due to complex modulation. Current deep learning approaches, limited to spatial denoising, often fail to address the global frequency-specific degradations caused by the mask structure. To address this, we propose a Physics-embedded Frequency-aware Transformer (PF-Trans) for high-fidelity remote sensing spectral reconstruction. Our method explicitly integrates the physical sensing model through mask injection and a gray-scale consistency loss to ensure physical fidelity. Furthermore, we introduce a Dual-domain Block with a parallel Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) branch, enabling the network to perceive and suppress aliasing artifacts in the frequency domain. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate that PF-Trans achieves state-of-the-art performance, achieving a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) of up to 48.50 dB on the GF-5 Shanghai dataset, significantly outperforming comparison methods.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种物理嵌入的频率感知Transformer（PF-Trans），用于高保真遥感光谱重建，通过掩模注入和灰度一致性损失保证物理保真度，并引入双域模块（含并行FFT分支）抑制频率混叠伪影，在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能，PSNR最高达48.50 dB。
AI.motivation: 快照宽带滤波阵列（BFA）成像虽具有高光通量优势，但由于复杂调制导致严重的光谱混叠。现有深度学习方法仅局限于空间域去噪，无法有效处理由掩模结构引起的全局频率特定退化。
AI.method: 提出PF-Trans模型：(1) 通过掩模注入和灰度一致性损失将物理传感模型显式集成到网络中；(2) 引入双域模块（Dual-domain Block），包含并行的FFT分支，使网络能够感知并抑制频域中的混叠伪影。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能，在GF-5上海数据集上PSNR最高达48.50 dB，显著优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: PF-Trans通过物理模型嵌入和频域感知机制，有效解决了BFA成像中的光谱混叠问题，实现了高保真遥感光谱重建。

title: Soul Computing: A Theoretical Framework and Technical Architecture for Intelligent Agents with Independent Consciousness
summary: Breakthroughs in large language models and multimodal generation technologies have propelled the digital reconstruction of human mental traits, emotional patterns, and long-term memory from science fiction toward engineering practice. Yet current research and industry practices at the intersection of AI and digital humans remain hampered by fundamental conceptual ambiguities: the essential differences between next-generation intelligent agents and traditional virtual humans, the construction pathways for digital entities possessing self-identity, and the core technical and ethical challenges confronting this domain all demand urgent clarification. This paper systematically examines the transformative logic underlying the transition from traditional virtual humans to the ``Soul Computing'' paradigm, driven by frontier AI technologies. We first analyze the evolutionary patterns of human consciousness and memory mechanisms, reassessing the core value of massive multimodal digital fragments in the reverse reconstruction of individual mental worlds. On this basis, we formally delineate the academic connotations of narrow and broad Soul Computing for the first time, clarifying its academic boundaries and essential distinctions from Affective Computing, Historical Reconstruction, and Mortal Computation. We argue that Soul Computing systems must architecturally construct an ``Intensional'' core rather than serving as purely ``Extensional'' functional carriers, thereby enabling the fundamental transition of AI from toolhood to living agency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“灵魂计算”范式，系统阐述了从传统虚拟人类向具备自我认同的智能体转变的理论框架，明确了狭义与广义灵魂计算的学术内涵及其与情感计算、历史重建等领域的本质区别。
AI.motivation: 当前AI与数字人交叉领域存在根本性概念模糊：下一代智能体与传统虚拟人类的本质区别、数字实体构建自我认同的路径、以及该领域面临的核心技术与伦理挑战均亟待厘清。
AI.method: 通过分析人类意识与记忆机制的演化规律，重新评估多模态数字碎片在个体精神世界反向重建中的核心价值，在此基础上首次正式界定狭义与广义灵魂计算的学术内涵。
AI.result: 明确了灵魂计算的学术边界及其与情感计算、历史重建、凡人计算（Mortal Computation）的本质区别，并提出灵魂计算系统必须在架构上构建“内涵式”核心而非仅作为“外延式”功能载体。
AI.conclusion: 灵魂计算范式能够实现AI从工具性向生命主体性的根本转变，为数字实体具备自我认同提供理论支撑。

title: WebChallenger: A Reliable and Efficient Generalist Web Agent
summary: Autonomous web navigation remains challenging for LLM agents, and the strongest generalist systems rely on proprietary reasoning models whose inference cost is prohibitive for the repetitive tasks where such agents would be most useful. We argue this gap stems not from insufficient model capability but from agent architectures that fail to replicate three human cognitive advantages: selective attention to relevant page regions, persistent memory of website structure, and procedural fluency with common interaction patterns. We introduce WebChallenger, a web agent framework that addresses each gap through architecture design rather than model scale, built around PageMem: a structured page representation deterministically constructed from the DOM that exposes each page as a hierarchy of semantic sections with short summaries. On this shared substrate we build three mechanisms that mirror the three cognitive advantages: a divide-and-conquer observation pipeline that lets the agent skim section summaries and extract details only from task-relevant regions; a lightweight exploration and memory system that traverses each website once to build a reusable map of pages and element behaviors; and compound action workflows that collapse common multi-step interactions into single agent actions, handling partial state changes automatically. Because all three operate over PageMem, the framework generalizes across websites without site-specific adapters. Using off-the-shelf open-weight models without fine-tuning, our system achieves 56.3% on WebArena, 48.7% on VisualWebArena, 51.0% on Online-Mind2Web, and 70.9% on WorkArena, approaching frontier proprietary systems at a fraction of the cost. Our code is released at https://github.com/jayoohwang1/webchallenger

AI.tldr: WebChallenger是一个基于PageMem结构的网页代理框架，通过选择性注意力、持久记忆和程序化流畅性三种认知机制，使用开源模型在多项Web导航基准上取得接近前沿商业系统的成绩，且成本大幅降低。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在自主网页导航任务中，最强系统依赖昂贵的专有推理模型，而这一差距并非模型能力不足，而是代理架构未能复制人类的三种认知优势：选择性关注相关页面区域、对网站结构的持久记忆、以及对常见交互模式的程序化流畅性。
AI.method: 构建PageMem结构化页面表示（从DOM确定性构建为带摘要的语义区域层级），在此基础上实现三种机制：（1）分治观测管线（先扫摘要再聚焦任务相关区域）；（2）轻量探索与记忆系统（遍历网站一次构建可复用的页面与元素行为地图）；（3）复合动作工作流（将多步交互折叠为单步动作并自动处理部分状态变化）。
AI.result: 使用开源离线模型且无需微调，在WebArena达56.3%，VisualWebArena达48.7%，Online-Mind2Web达51.0%，WorkArena达70.9%，接近前沿专有系统但成本大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构设计而非模型规模扩展，可以有效弥合开源模型与专有系统在Web导航任务上的差距，PageMem结构是实现这一目标的关键共享基础。

title: Trace2Policy: From Expert Behavior Traces to Self-Evolving Decision Agents
summary: Decision rules that enterprise experts apply tacitly -- in auditing, compliance, and contract review -- can be systematically recovered and improved through iterative error analysis. We present \textbf{Trace2Policy}, whose core mechanism -- \textbf{EISR} (\textbf{E}rror-driven \textbf{I}terative \textbf{S}kill \textbf{R}efinement) -- maintains a human-readable rule document as its optimization target: each round executes the rules on a validation set, clusters errors by root cause into MISSING, WRONG, or CONFLICT types, applies targeted patches, and commits only those that pass a regression gate. \textbf{For this class of compliance-sensitive, skewed-base-rate decision tasks, we identify rule quality -- not model capability -- as the dominant performance lever}: across five LLMs, one-shot distillation plateaus near $\sim$70\% on the deployed pool, while eight EISR rounds lift the same rules to 79.6\% when compiled into deterministic Python -- zero LLM calls at inference. \textbf{Execution form compounds the gain: in production, the same EISR-refined content runs 9.8~pp higher as compiled Python than as an LLM prompt, a form-and-engineering bundle the 22-day deployment matured together.} Deployed for 22 days at a major logistics carrier (3,349 audit cases), the compiled pipeline outperforms the pure-LLM baseline it replaced (72.7\%); on these calibrated, skewed-base-rate workloads, re-enabling LLM fallback monotonically degrades accuracy. An LLM-driven variant, \textbf{Auto-EISR}, reproduces this refinement at \$5--\$10 per cycle versus $\sim$70 expert-hours, and transfers to four public benchmarks spanning legal reasoning (LegalBench) and process-mining decisions (BPIC 2012) without re-engineering.

AI.tldr: Trace2Policy通过EISR机制（错误驱动迭代技能优化），从专家隐性决策规则中系统性地提炼和改进规则，最终以Python代码形式部署，在生产环境中比LLM提示方式准确率高9.8个百分点，且无需LLM推理调用。
AI.motivation: 企业专家在审计、合规、合同审查等任务中依赖隐性决策规则，但这些规则缺乏系统性的提取和优化方法，现有LLM方案在偏态基线的合规敏感任务上性能 plateau 在~70%。
AI.method: 提出EISR机制：维护可读规则文档作为优化目标，每轮在验证集执行规则，按根因将错误聚类为MISSING/WRONG/CONFLICT三类，应用针对性补丁，仅通过回归验证的补丁才被采纳。最终将规则编译为确定性Python代码，实现零LLM调用推理。
AI.result: 在5个LLM上，一次蒸馏plateau在~70%；8轮EISR提升到79.6%（编译为Python）。生产部署22天（3,349个审计案例），编译管道准确率72.7%，超越纯LLM基线；启用LLM回退反而单调降低准确率。Auto-EISR变体每轮仅$5-$10成本（vs专家~70工时），且零迁移工程在LegalBench等4个公开基准上复现。
AI.conclusion: 对于合规敏感、偏态基线的决策任务，规则质量（而非模型能力）是性能的主导杠杆；规则的正确形式（编译为确定性代码 vs LLM提示）和工程部署共同带来显著增益。

title: Which LoRA? An Empirical Study on the Effectiveness of LoRA Techniques During Multilingual Instruction Tuning
summary: We investigate whether commonly available LoRA variants have an advantage over basic LoRA in multilingual instruction tuning. Experiments involving LoRA and four other variants on two datasets across diverse target languages show that there is no significant advantage in using more complex LoRA variants instead of basic LoRA, with respect to balancing cross-lingual transfer and knowledge retention. An analysis of hidden embeddings reveal that layer-wise language representation remains largely similar across LLMs fine-tuned with different LoRA techniques, suggesting that architectural novelty of LoRA techniques may not translate into better cross-lingual adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了多种LoRA变体在多语言指令微调中的表现，发现基础LoRA与更复杂的变体相比，在跨语言迁移和知识保留的平衡上并无显著优势。
AI.motivation: 探究常用的LoRA变体是否比基础LoRA在多语言指令微调中更具优势。
AI.method: 在多个目标语言上，使用两种数据集，对基础LoRA和四种变体进行实验对比。
AI.result: 复杂LoRA变体相比基础LoRA在跨语言迁移和知识保留平衡上无显著优势；不同LoRA技术微调的大模型在层间语言表示上高度相似。
AI.conclusion: LoRA技术的架构创新不一定能带来更好的跨语言适应能力。

title: ComBench: A Benchmark for Rigorous Proof Reasoning and Constructive Realization in Olympiad-Level Combinatorics
summary: Combinatorics is central to Olympiad-level mathematical problem solving, requiring deep discrete reasoning, creative constructions, and rigorous structural insight. Recent evidence suggests that even today's strongest frontier models remain uneven on Olympiad combinatorics, revealing a gap in creative mathematical reasoning. We introduce ComBench, an Olympiad-level combinatorics benchmark for evaluating and diagnosing the combinatorial reasoning capabilities of large language models. ComBench contains 100 human-annotated competition-level problems organized around two complementary settings: analysis-centric problems, which primarily require rigorous mathematical arguments, and construction-centric problems, which require explicit constructions in addition to correctness justifications. The evaluation protocol combines rubric-guided proof grading with deterministic construction verification, exposing cases where proof quality and construction validity diverge. Experiments on frontier open- and closed-source models show that ComBench is far from saturated: the strongest model reaches 65.4% overall Avg. and 75.3% overall Best@4. We further find that Rigorous Proof Reasoning and Constructive Realization are distinct capabilities: Kimi-K2.6 trails GPT-5.5 on analysis-centric proof grading but surpasses it on construction-centric Best@4, while Existence and Construction problems remain consistently hardest across representative frontier models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍ComBench，一个包含100道奥赛级组合数学题的基准，用于评估大语言模型的组合推理能力，涵盖分析型和构造型两类问题。实验表明最强模型仅达65.4%准确率，且证明推理与构造实现是两种独立能力。
AI.motivation: 当前最强的前沿大模型在奥赛级组合数学问题上表现不均，存在创造性数学推理的差距，缺乏针对性的评估基准来诊断这一能力不足。
AI.method: 构建包含100道人工标注的竞赛级组合数学题，分为分析主导型（侧重严谨证明）和构造主导型（需显式构造+正确性证明）；采用评分标准引导的证明评分与确定性构造验证相结合的双轨评估协议。
AI.result: 最强模型整体平均65.4%，Best@4达75.3%；Kimi-K2.6在分析型证明评分上落后GPT-5.5，但在构造型Best@4上超越后者；存在性与构造类问题对各类前沿模型始终最难。
AI.conclusion: ComBench远未饱和，证明推理与构造实现是两种可分离的独立能力，当前模型在深层组合推理上仍有显著提升空间。

title: CoCoSI: Collaborative Cognitive Map Construction for Spatial Intelligence
summary: Spatial intelligence is a key frontier for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), enabling them to reason about the physical world from visual experience. Inspired by human spatial cognition, recent approaches construct grid-based cognitive maps from multi-frame visual inputs to maintain coherent spatial representations over time. However, limited context lengths still challenge spatial understanding, while existing methods, such as long-context modeling and external memory, often require architectural changes, memory modules, or finetuning, limiting their applicability to off-the-shelf pretrained MLLMs. This motivates a lightweight, model-agnostic method for preserving spatial information beyond the native context window. To this end, we propose a plug-and-play multi-agent framework that collaboratively constructs cognitive maps as structured spatial memory, enhancing the spatial understanding of arbitrary pretrained MLLMs without architectural modification or additional training. Our framework features local-global agent coordination, cognitive map construction with atomic commits, and cross-agent verification. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance on spatial understanding tasks while remaining fully training-free. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种即插即用的多智能体框架，通过构建认知地图作为结构化空间记忆，无需架构修改或额外训练即可增强任意预训练多模态大模型的空间理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在处理多帧视觉输入时受限于上下文长度，而长上下文建模或外部记忆方法往往需要架构修改或微调，缺乏轻量级、模型无关的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出即插即用的多智能体框架，包含局部-全局智能体协作、带原子提交的认知地图构建以及跨智能体验证机制。
AI.result: 在空间理解任务上取得了优越性能，且完全无需训练。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了预训练MLLM在空间信息保持上的局限性，是一种轻量级、模型无关且无需额外训练的通用解决方案。

title: LakeQA: An Exploratory QA Benchmark over a Million-Scale Data Lake
summary: Recent large language models (LLMs) have shown rapid progress in reading-based question answering (QA), where evidence is explicitly provided or can be trivially retrieved. In contrast, real-world questions are often not paired with accurate evidence documents. The useful evidence resides in massive data lakes, making search a prerequisite for answering. However, there is a lack of comprehensive benchmarks that require both searching and reasoning over large data lakes. To this end, we introduce LakeQA, a comprehensive benchmark for search-centric question answering over data lakes that jointly emphasizes searching and reasoning capabilities. LakeQA is built on a heterogeneous collection of approximately 9.5 TB of text resources from Wikipedia and open-source government data, spanning structured and unstructured data. To ensure task quality, each sample is annotated by at least one Ph.D.-level expert. Each task requires long-horizon multi-hop reasoning with implicit intermediate steps: agents need to discover the correct documents and then compose evidence across sources to produce the answer. Experimental results on seven frontier LLMs demonstrate that LakeQA is challenging. For instance, GPT-5.2 achieves only an exact-match score of 18.37% on LakeQA. Overall, LakeQA provides a realistic testbed for developing LLM agents that can both find and analyze data in modern data lakes.

AI.tldr: LakeQA是一个需要同时进行搜索和推理的大规模数据湖问答基准，包含约9.5TB的异构文本资源（维基百科和开源政府数据），由博士级专家标注。实验表明，即使是GPT-5.2也仅获得18.37%的精确匹配分数，说明该基准极具挑战性。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在提供明确证据的阅读理解问答中表现良好，但真实场景下问题往往无法直接获取准确证据，需要在海量数据湖中进行搜索和推理，而目前缺乏同时评估搜索和推理能力的综合基准。
AI.method: 构建了约9.5TB的异构文本数据湖（含结构化与非结构化数据），由至少一位博士级专家标注每个样本，任务需要多跳推理和跨文档证据组合。
AI.result: 对7个前沿大语言模型进行评测，GPT-5.2仅达到18.37%的精确匹配分数，表明LakeQA极具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: LakeQA为开发需要在现代数据湖中同时进行数据查找和分析的LLM智能体提供了一个现实且具有挑战性的测试平台。

title: A complementary study on PlanGPT: Evaluation with defined Performance Metrics and comparison with a planner
summary:
Automated Planning is a subfield of Artificial Intelligence (AI) where the main objective is generating a sequence of actions, known as a plan, that helps us reach a goal state from an initial state. A planning problem is defined by a set of objects, an initial state and a desired goal state. The objective is to compute a plan that'll lead us from the inital state to the goal state. Programs that generate plans are called planners.
  In this paper, we did a complementary study to the state-of-the-art LLM called PlanGPT which was released last year. We redid some experiments to verify whether planning with LLMs is \textbf{pertinent} and \textbf{worthwhile}. We also check whether the results obtained in the official PlanGPT paper for plan coverage were correct, and we also performed a more comprehensive study on PlanGPT's performance: in our paper PlanGPT's performance was evaluated using two metrics: Plan Cost and Plan Generation Time. The results of planGPT were compared to those produced by a traditional planner for the same plans and same metrics. We discovered that PlanGPT is no better than a Greedy search strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文对PlanGPT进行了补充性实验研究，发现该模型在规划任务中的表现并不优于简单的贪婪搜索策略，质疑了使用LLM进行规划的有效性和价值。
AI.motivation: 验证使用大语言模型（LLM）进行规划是否真正有效和有价值，并对PlanGPT论文中报告的规划覆盖率结果进行复现检验。
AI.method: 对PlanGPT进行补充实验，使用计划成本（Plan Cost）和计划生成时间（Plan Generation Time）两个指标，将其结果与传统规划器及贪婪搜索策略进行对比。
AI.result: PlanGPT的性能不优于简单的贪婪搜索策略，并且对其在规划覆盖率方面的结果提出了质疑。
AI.conclusion: 使用LLM进行规划可能并不如预期那样有效，PlanGPT的实际表现有限，传统方法或简单策略可能更具竞争力。

title: Vision-Assisted Foundation Model for Solving Multi-Task Vehicle Routing Problems
summary: Multi-task vehicle routing problems play a critical role in enhancing efficiency across various industries and service sectors. These problems consist of multiple variants that optimize routing costs while meeting diverse customer constraints. Existing multi-task VRP solvers solely utilize a graph-based modality, limiting their ability to address variants with multiple constraints. As a format to represent complex semantics, vision modality shows great potential for encoding diverse VRP constraints. This motivates us to learn patch-level semantics from the vision images, and then integrate them into a graph-based model to solve various VRP variants simultaneously. However, directly applying this approach to multi-task VRPs presents three challenges: 1) existing VRP images lack constraint representations, which are essential for multi-task VRPs, 2) the fixed receptive field of individual patches cannot effectively accommodate varying requirements across tasks, and 3) imbalanced pixel distribution among constraints may cause the model to overlook constraints with fewer pixels. In this paper, we propose a vision-assisted foundation model (VaFM) to address these challenges. In the vision modality, input images tailored to all constraints are encoded by a convolutional neural network. The obtained patch embeddings are fused with graph-based nodes to generate solutions, with an auxiliary task designed to address the pixel-imbalanced issue. The performance of VaFM is evaluated across 16 different VRP variants. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of VaFM over state-of-the-art methods, especially for variants with complex constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种视觉辅助基础模型（VaFM），通过将视觉模态（约束图像）与图模态相结合，解决了多任务车辆路径问题（VRP）中现有方法仅依赖图模态、难以处理多约束变体的局限性。实验在16种VRP变体上验证了VaFM的优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有多任务VRP求解器仅使用图模态，难以应对具有多种约束的变体。视觉模态具有编码复杂语义的能力，有望用于表示多样的VRP约束，从而提升多任务VRP的性能。
AI.method: 提出VaFM模型：1）在视觉模态中，为所有约束生成定制输入图像，并通过CNN编码为patch嵌入；2）将patch嵌入与基于图的节点嵌入融合生成解决方案；3）设计辅助任务解决约束间像素分布不平衡问题。
AI.result: 在16种不同的VRP变体上进行了评估，结果表明VaFM在性能上优于最先进的方法，尤其是在具有复杂约束的变体上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 视觉辅助方法能有效增强多任务VRP对复杂约束的表达与求解能力，为多模态融合在组合优化问题中的应用提供了新思路。

title: Large Language Models as Modal Models in Linguistics
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has intensified debates about their significance for linguistic theory. These debates are commonly divided into three positions: insulationism, which regards LLMs as irrelevant to human language; eliminativism, which claims that LLMs can replace traditional linguistic theories; and conciliationism, which views them as useful tools for linguistic research. To clarify these positions, this paper applies the framework of modal modeling from the philosophy of science. We argue that LLMs possess genuine epistemic value as minimal models, even without structural correspondence to human cognition. In particular, they can provide how-possibly explanations (HPEs) by testing modal claims about language acquisition and linguistic competence. We then examine the conditions under which LLMs could qualify as how-actually explanations (HAEs) of human language, drawing on the mechanistic account of scientific explanation. We argue that current LLMs do not yet satisfy these requirements. On the basis of this analysis, we propose understanding the explanatory power of LLMs as lying on a continuum between HPEs and HAEs. This framework avoids both overstating and understating their explanatory significance and offers a more precise basis for evaluating the role of LLMs in the scientific study of language.

AI.tldr: 本文从科学哲学中的模态建模框架出发，将LLM视为“最小模型”，认为它们虽不直接对应人类认知结构，但能提供“可能如何解释”（HPEs），并在“实际如何解释”（HAEs）的连续谱上评估其解释力。
AI.motivation: LLM对语言学理论的意义存在激烈争论，分为绝缘主义、消除主义和调和主义三种立场，但缺乏一个清晰的理论框架来评估LLM的真正价值。
AI.method: 应用科学哲学中的模态建模框架，将LLM分析为最小模型，并借鉴科学解释的机制主义观点，区分HPEs与HAEs。
AI.result: LLM具有作为最小模型的真正认知价值，能通过测试关于语言习得和能力的模态主张来提供可能如何解释；但当前LLM尚不符合实际如何解释的条件。
AI.conclusion: LLM的解释力位于HPEs与HAEs之间的连续谱上，这一框架既避免夸大也避免低估其解释意义，为评估LLM在语言科学研究中的作用提供了更精确的基础。

title: A Reliable Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Belief Rule Base Consider Robustness Analysis
summary: In equipment operation, the implementation of fault diagnosis is essential to ensure the continuity and safety of production equipment, improve operational efficiency and reduce maintenance costs. Since sensor readings are widely used for fault diagnosis, their reliability directly affects the results of fault diagnosis. A new fault diagnosis method is proposed to address the two problems of robustness assessment and robustness optimization of fault diagnosis models. For this purpose, a reliable fault diagnosis method based on a belief rule base (BRB) considering robustness analysis is proposed. Firstly, the robustness analysis of the BRB model is carried out systematically. Secondly, three robustness constraint strategies are proposed to optimize the robustness of the BRB fault diagnosis model. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by taking the fault diagnosis of WD615 diesel engine and Case Western Reserve University bearings as an example, and the experiments show that the proposed model improves both accuracy and robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于置信规则库(BRB)的鲁棒故障诊断方法，通过鲁棒性分析和三种约束策略优化，在柴油机和轴承故障诊断实验中同时提升了准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传感器读数的可靠性直接影响故障诊断结果，现有方法缺乏对故障诊断模型鲁棒性评估和鲁棒性优化的系统性考虑。
AI.method: 1. 对BRB模型进行系统性鲁棒性分析；2. 提出三种鲁棒性约束策略优化BRB故障诊断模型；3. 通过WD615柴油机和凯斯西储大学轴承故障诊断验证有效性。
AI.result: 所提出的模型在故障诊断中同时提高了准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 基于BRB并考虑鲁棒性分析的故障诊断方法能够有效应对传感器可靠性问题，在提升诊断精度的同时增强了模型的鲁棒性。

title: Few-step Generative Models as Lossy Compression
summary: DiffC provides a principled way to reuse pre-trained diffusion models for lossy compression, but its encoding and decoding procedures remain slow because they require many discretized forward and reverse steps. We study whether few-step generative models -- Rectified Flow, Consistency Trajectory Models (CTM), and MeanFlow -- can be cast as codecs within the same reverse channel coding (RCC) framework. The main challenge is that RCC requires posterior and shared distribution parameters, whereas these models do not explicitly parameterize intermediate conditional distributions. For Rectified Flow and MeanFlow, we use the equivalence between velocity parameterization and diffusion-style denoising parameterization to derive the quantities required by RCC. For CTM, which is distilled from EDM, we adopt the EDM noise parameterization together with local Gaussian approximations of the sender and shared distributions at intermediate states. This yields a proof-of-concept probabilistic formulation that enables compression with pre-trained few-step generative models without retraining. On low-resolution benchmarks, the resulting codecs reduce encoding and decoding time and improve realism in the low-bit-rate regime.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了如何将少步生成模型（Rectified Flow、CTM、MeanFlow）应用于反向信道编码框架进行有损压缩，通过推导所需的条件分布参数，实现了无需重新训练的压缩编解码器，在低分辨率基准上显著提升了编解码速度并改善了低比特率下的真实性。
AI.motivation: DiffC虽能复用预训练扩散模型进行有损压缩，但其编解码过程因需要大量离散化前向和反向步骤而速度缓慢，因此作者探索能否将少步生成模型应用于同一框架以加速。
AI.method: 针对Rectified Flow和MeanFlow，利用速度参数化与扩散去噪参数化的等价性推导RCC所需量；针对CTM，采用EDM噪声参数化结合中间状态的局部高斯近似，构建概率公式以实现无需重新训练的压缩编解码器。
AI.result: 在低分辨率基准上，所提出的编解码器显著减少了编解码时间，并在低比特率下提升了图像的真实性。
AI.conclusion: 预训练的少步生成模型可被改造为高效的有损压缩编解码器，在不重新训练的情况下实现速度与质量的平衡。

title: Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation without Paired Data: Theoretical Foundation and Algorithm
summary: Cross-modal knowledge distillation (CMKD) studies how a (large) teacher model trained on one type of data (e.g., images) can guide a (smaller) student model building on another type of data (e.g., text/audio). Existing CMKD methods often require paired multi-modal data with aligned semantics, but obtaining such paired data are often costly and impractical. To mitigate this limitation, we develop a new CMKD framework for the more challenging setting where paired data are unavailable. In particular, we establish a cross-modal distributional relationship between teacher and student models, which reveals two fundamental quantities governing effective distillation: feature alignment and label alignment. These quantities characterize semantic discrepancy between modalities at the levels of representation and prediction distributions, respectively. Motivated by this insight, we propose a principled framework, with theoretical guarantees, that enables effective cross-modal knowledge distillation by aligning distributions rather than individual samples. Extensive experiments across a wide range of multimodal benchmarks show that our framework is highly effective in both unpaired and paired data settings, improving significantly over prior work.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需配对数据的跨模态知识蒸馏框架，通过分布对齐实现有效的知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态知识蒸馏方法通常需要昂贵的配对多模态数据，实际应用中难以获取。
AI.method: 建立跨模态分布关系，提出基于特征对齐和标签对齐的分布对齐框架，并给出理论保证。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准上，无论有无配对数据，均显著优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过分布对齐而非样本对齐，可有效解决无配对数据下的跨模态知识蒸馏问题。

title: Geometric Coastline Localization using Vision-Language Models
summary: Coastline detection in remote sensing imagery is commonly formulated as a pixel-wise segmentation problem, where the final coastline is extracted from a predicted mask through post-processing. This formulation relegates coastline geometry, the primary representation used in coastal change analysis, to a secondary artifact rather than the learning objective. In practice, coastlines are defined by geomorphic proxies such as vegetation lines, dune toes, or cliff edges, rather than an instantaneous land-water boundary often used in pixel-based segmentation approaches. In this work, we revisit coastline extraction from a representation perspective and formulate the task as geometric boundary localization. We use the New Zealand Coastal Change Dataset (NZCCD) and high-resolution aerial imagery from Land Information New Zealand (LINZ) to develop CoastlineVLM-7B, a vision-language model (VLM) built on the GeoChat-7B/LLaVA-1.5 architecture that jointly performs coastline presence detection, proxy-type classification, and coastline grounding. The model directly predicts a coastline as a polyline rather than a dense segmentation mask. We evaluate CoastlineVLM-7B against segmentation baselines under strict one-pixel boundary supervision. Results show that geometry-based metrics are more suitable for assessing coastline localization quality than pixel-overlap metrics such as Intersection over Union (IoU). CoastlineVLM-7B improves global geometric alignment with reference coastlines, reducing Hausdorff distance from 37.74 m to 31.84 m and Earth Mover's Distance from 21.12 m to 17.32 m. These results indicate that output representation is a critical design choice in coastline extraction, and that geometry-oriented learning, combined with the semantic reasoning capabilities of vision-language models, aligns well with how coastlines are defined and evaluated in operational coastal monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CoastlineVLM-7B，将海岸线提取从像素分割问题重新定义为几何边界定位问题，直接预测折线而非分割掩码，在几何指标上显著优于传统分割方法。
AI.motivation: 传统海岸线提取将问题建模为像素级分割，海岸线几何形态仅是后处理的副产品而非学习目标；此外，真实海岸线由植被线、沙丘趾等地理代理定义，而非瞬时水陆边界，现有方法存在表征不匹配问题。
AI.method: 基于 GeoChat-7B/LLaVA-1.5 架构构建视觉语言模型 CoastlineVLM-7B，联合执行海岸线存在检测、代理类型分类和海岸线定位，直接预测折线而非密集分割掩码。
AI.result: 在严格单像素边界监督下，CoastlineVLM-7B 将 Hausdorff 距离从 37.74m 降至 31.84m，Earth Mover's Distance 从 21.12m 降至 17.32m；几何指标比像素重叠指标（如 IoU）更适合评估海岸线定位质量。
AI.conclusion: 输出表征是海岸线提取的关键设计选择；面向几何的学习结合视觉语言模型的语义推理能力，与海岸监测中海岸线的定义和评估方式更一致。

title: UniSVQ: 2-bit Unified Scalar-Vector Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization at the 2-bit level enables low-cost deployment and inference acceleration for large language models (LLMs). Scalar quantization (SQ) and vector quantization (VQ) are two primary quantization methods, however, the former suffers from significant performance degradation, and the latter incurs computational and storage overhead. We propose UniSVQ, a unified 2-bit quantization framework that bridges scalar and vector quantization by parameterizing codewords as an affine transform of integer lattices. This structure preserves compatibility with optimized integer kernels while retaining much of VQ's flexibility. We further introduce a data-driven block-wise fine-tuning strategy to directly minimize quantization reconstruction error. Extensive experiments across multiple LLM families and zero-shot benchmarks demonstrate that UniSVQ consistently outperforms state-of-the-art SQ methods and achieves performance comparable to advanced VQ methods, while providing higher inference throughput.

AI.tldr: UniSVQ是一个统一的2-bit量化框架，通过将码字参数化为整数格的仿射变换，桥接了标量量化（SQ）和向量量化（VQ）两种方法，在保持与优化整数内核兼容的同时，保留了VQ的灵活性，并通过数据驱动的块级微调策略最小化量化重建误差。实验表明，UniSVQ在多个LLM和零样本基准上优于先进SQ方法，性能与高级VQ方法相当，且推理吞吐量更高。
AI.motivation: 2-bit级别的后训练量化能够实现大语言模型的低成本部署和推理加速。现有的标量量化（SQ）性能下降严重，而向量量化（VQ）则存在计算和存储开销大的问题。因此需要一种兼顾性能与效率的统一量化方法。
AI.method: 提出UniSVQ统一2-bit量化框架，将码字参数化为整数格的仿射变换，从而桥接SQ和VQ；引入数据驱动的块级微调策略，直接最小化量化重建误差。
AI.result: 在多个LLM家族和零样本基准测试上，UniSVQ一致优于最先进的SQ方法，性能与高级VQ方法相当，同时推理吞吐量更高。
AI.conclusion: UniSVQ有效地结合了SQ的高效性和VQ的灵活性，在2-bit量化场景下实现了性能与效率的良好平衡，为大语言模型的低成本部署提供了有前景的方案。

title: HIPIF: Hierarchical Planning and Information Folding for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Learning
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities as autonomous agents across a wide range of tasks, their performance often degrades in multi-turn long-horizon agentic tasks. Existing methods have made progress through fine-grained credit assignment to alleviate long-horizon sparse rewards and hierarchical reinforcement learning to decompose tasks and reduce long-term dependency. However, these methods still do not directly address long-context interference, in which continuously growing histories weaken the agent's ability to track the global task state and impair subsequent reasoning and decision-making. Inspired by the way humans handle complex tasks through subgoal decomposition and completed progress summarization, we propose Hierarchical Planning and Information Folding (HIPIF) for long-horizon LLM agent learning. HIPIF trains the agent end-to-end to organize long-horizon execution around explicit subgoals while folding completed subgoal histories to reduce long-context interference. Furthermore, to stabilize subgoal-based planning and execution, HIPIF combines hierarchical reflection and subgoal-oriented process rewards to guide subgoal generation, transition, and execution, without relying on costly auxiliary models or task-specific expert trajectories. Extensive experiments on three publicly available agentic benchmarks demonstrate the validity of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为HIPIF的方法，通过分层规划和信息折叠来解决LLM在长程多轮智能体任务中的长上下文干扰问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（如细粒度信用分配、分层强化学习）未能直接解决长上下文干扰问题——持续增长的交互历史削弱了智能体追踪全局任务状态的能力，影响后续推理与决策。
AI.method: 提出HIPIF框架：1) 端到端训练智能体围绕显式子目标组织长程执行；2) 折叠已完成的子目标历史以减少长上下文干扰；3) 结合分层反思和子目标导向的过程奖励来稳定子目标生成、转换和执行，无需昂贵辅助模型或专家轨迹。
AI.result: 在三个公开的智能体基准测试上的广泛实验证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: HIPIF通过子目标分解和历史信息折叠有效缓解了长上下文干扰，提升了LLM在长程多轮任务中的表现。

title: LC-QAT: Data-Efficient 2-Bit QAT for LLMs via Linear-Constrained Vector Quantization
summary: Quantization-aware training (QAT) is essential for extremely low-bit large language models (LLMs). Current QAT methods are mainly based on scalar quantization (SQ), which enables efficient optimization but suffers from severe performance degradation at 2-bit precision. On the other hand, vector quantization (VQ) provides substantially higher representational capacity, but its discrete codebook lookup prevents end-to-end training. We propose LC-QAT, a 2-bit weight-only VQ-QAT framework that represents quantized weights via a learned affine mapping over discrete vectors, which yields a high-quality PTQ initialization and enables fully differentiable end-to-end optimization without explicit codebook lookup in the training forward pass. This strong post-training initialization makes LC-QAT highly data-efficient. Experiments across diverse LLMs demonstrate that LC-QAT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art QAT methods while using only 0.1%--10% of the training data. Our results establish LC-QAT as a practical and scalable solution for extreme low-bit model deployment.

AI.tldr: LC-QAT提出了一种用于2比特权重量化的可微向量量化训练框架，通过仿射映射替代离散码本查找，在仅用0.1%-10%训练数据的情况下超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有标量量化（SQ）在2-bit精度下性能严重下降，而向量量化（VQ）虽表征能力强但离散码本查找导致无法端到端训练，亟需一种兼具两者优势的量化感知训练方法。
AI.method: 提出LC-QAT框架：用学习到的仿射映射（learned affine mapping）表示量化的离散向量，避免显式码本查找，从而实现完全可微的端到端优化；同时采用高质量的PTQ初始化提升数据效率。
AI.result: 在多种LLM上，LC-QAT仅使用0.1%-10%的训练数据，即在2-bit权重量化任务中持续优于现有SOTA方法。
AI.conclusion: LC-QAT为极端低位模型部署提供了一种实用且可扩展的方案，验证了VQ-QAT结合可微训练的有效性。

title: ActiveMem: Distributed Active Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Reasoning
summary: Memory is essential for enabling large language model (LLM) agents to handle long-horizon reasoning tasks. Existing memory mechanisms are largely centralized, typically organizing retrieved information and interaction history within a single model context. This design imposes a fundamental trade-off: scaling reasoning trajectories risks context overload, whereas aggressive content pruning may result in irreversible information loss. Seeking a better trade-off, we draw inspiration from human cognitive systems, especially the functional complementarity between the prefrontal cortex (executive control) and the hippocampus (memory management), suggesting that such a trade-off need not be inherent, but may instead stem from centralized memory organization. To this end, we propose ActiveMem, a heterogeneous framework that decouples agent memory from the core reasoning process. Specifically, a high-level Planner utilizes distilled semantic gists to execute reasoning, while a lightweight, distributed memory system operates in parallel to actively accumulate and consolidate these gists throughout the task. Experiments on BrowseComp-Plus and GAIA show that ActiveMem achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with significantly reduced overhead, demonstrating the effectiveness of distributed active memory for long-horizon reasoning.

AI.tldr: ActiveMem提出一种异构记忆框架，将智能体记忆与核心推理过程解耦，通过高层规划器使用精简语义要点进行推理，并配合轻量级分布式记忆系统主动积累要点，在长时推理任务上实现了SOTA性能且开销显著降低。
AI.motivation: 现有集中式记忆机制在长时推理中面临上下文过载与信息丢失之间的权衡困境，受人类认知系统中前额皮层（执行控制）与海马体（记忆管理）功能互补的启发，探索解耦记忆与推理的可行方案。
AI.method: 提出ActiveMem异构框架：1) 高层Planner利用蒸馏的语义要点进行推理；2) 轻量级分布式记忆系统并行运行，在任务过程中主动积累和整合这些要点。将记忆管理与核心推理过程解耦。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp-Plus和GAIA基准上，ActiveMem实现了最先进的准确率，同时显著降低了计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 分布式主动记忆机制能有效解决集中式记忆的权衡问题，验证了将记忆与推理解耦对长时推理任务的有效性。

title: 5% > 100%: Flatness Preference is All You Need for Multimodal Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods provide a streamlined and efficient tool for adapting large models to domain-specific multimodal downstream tasks. Although these methods proved their tangible effects in practice, their principal aspects remain under-explored. Therefore we remain curious about the underlying generalization mechanisms in various PEFT methods and how they can be further enhanced. In this paper, we reveal the flatness preference widely present in various PEFTs, where a small fraction of sharp dimensions dominates the generalization of PEFT. This finding suggests an appealing possibility: we may be satisfied with a better generalization by merely attending to this small fraction of sharp dimensions instead of all of them. Furthermore, we propose Flatness Preference Optimization (FlatPO) to flatten these key sharpness dimensions, leading various PEFTs toward better generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our findings and the proposed method. Code is available at https://github.com/Can-Lin/FlatPO.

AI.tldr: 本文发现PEFT方法普遍存在“平坦偏好”现象，即少数尖锐维度主导泛化性能，并提出FlatPO方法仅针对这些关键维度进行平坦化优化，从而提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法虽然实用，但其泛化机制尚不明确，作者希望探究不同PEFT方法背后的泛化原理，并进一步改进其泛化性能。
AI.method: 首先揭示了PEFT中普遍存在的平坦偏好现象——少量尖锐维度主导泛化；进而提出Flatness Preference Optimization (FlatPO)，仅针对这些关键尖锐维度进行平坦化优化，而非对所有维度进行优化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所发现的现象和提出的FlatPO方法均能有效提升PEFT的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过关注少量关键尖锐维度并进行平坦化优化，可以显著提升各种PEFT方法的泛化能力，为理解PEFT原理和改进提供了新视角。

title: Prefilling-dLLM: Predictive Prefilling for Long-Context Inference in Diffusion Language Models
summary:
Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) re-encode the entire prefix at every denoising step, causing recomputation that scales
  quadratically with context length and becomes prohibitive for long-context scenarios. We propose Prefilling-dLLM, a training-free
  prefill-decode disaggregation framework for dLLMs that partitions the prefix into N chunks, caches their KV representations once,
  and selects the top-K most relevant chunks with intra-chunk token sparsity for decoding, showing that sparse prefilling can
  outperform dense attention while reducing per-step complexity from quadratic in the full sequence length to quadratic only in the
  decode length. On LongBench and InfiniteBench, Prefilling-dLLM achieves state-of-the-art quality among dLLM acceleration methods,
  and an attention kernel that parallelizes decoding over the non-contiguously cached chunk KV yields 9.1--28.0x speedup at 8K--32K
  contexts. We further show that beginning-of-sequence tokens prepended to each chunk act as periodic attention anchors that eliminate
  the lost-in-the-middle phenomenon. Code is available at https://github.com/menik1126/Prefilling-dLLM.

AI.tldr: 提出Prefilling-dLLM框架，通过分块缓存KV表示和稀疏预填充，将dLLM解码复杂度从全序列二次降至仅解码长度二次，实现9.1-28倍加速且消除中间丢失现象。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）在每个去噪步骤中重新编码整个前缀，导致计算复杂度随上下文长度呈二次增长，在长上下文场景下变得不可接受。
AI.method: 训练无关的预填充-解码分离框架：将前缀划分为N个块并缓存其KV表示，选择top-K最相关块进行解码，利用块内token稀疏性，使预填充复杂度从全序列二次降至仅解码长度二次。
AI.result: 在LongBench和InfiniteBench上达到dLLM加速方法中的最优质量；在8K-32K上下文下实现9.1-28.0倍加速；序列开头token作为周期性注意力锚点消除中间丢失现象。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏预填充可超越密集注意力，为dLLM长上下文加速提供了高效且无损的解决方案。

title: One Token per Multimodal Evidence: Latent Memory for Resource-Constrained QA
summary: External memory effectively grounds large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs)-based question answering (QA) in relevant multimodal evidence. However, existing memory paradigms represent each memory item in raw text and image forms, so retrieval-based systems must pass the retrieved text or images to the generation LLMs/VLMs, resulting in high token consumption and storage pressure, making it unaffordable for resource-constrained applications. We propose Latent Memory, a latent-space memory paradigm that replaces each raw text or image evidence item with a single high-dimensional latent token produced by a small compressor LLM/VLM. Rather than retrieving raw evidence for generation, Latent Memory operates in a unified latent representation space: the query is embedded into this space to retrieve relevant latent tokens, and the retrieved latent tokens are directly prompted to a pretrained LLM or VLM for answer generation. To make each latent token simultaneously informative for reconstruction, retrieval, and generation, we train the compressor with reconstruction, contrastive, and distillation objectives in a unified end-to-end manner. Latent Memory is evaluated on seven text-only QA benchmarks (e.g., HotpotQA) and multimodal QA benchmarks, where it achieves competitive QA performance compared to advanced RAG baselines while consuming 3x to 10x fewer generator tokens. It can also deliver the strongest image-grounded QA performance on WebQA. Code is available at https://github.com/zz1358m/Latent-Memory-Master.

AI.tldr: 提出Latent Memory，一种将外部记忆压缩为潜在空间令牌的方法，在减少3-10倍生成令牌消耗的同时，在文本和多模态QA任务上达到与RAG相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法将外部记忆以原始文本/图像形式存储，导致高令牌消耗和存储压力，难以应用于资源受限场景。
AI.method: 每个证据项被压缩为单个高维潜在令牌；通过重建、对比和蒸馏目标联合训练压缩器；查询和检索均在统一潜在空间中进行。
AI.result: 在7个文本QA和多个多模态QA基准上，与先进RAG基线竞争效果相当，生成令牌消耗减少3-10倍；在WebQA上取得最强图像问答性能。
AI.conclusion: 潜在空间记忆范式能有效降低资源消耗而不牺牲QA性能，为资源受限应用提供可行方案。

title: PathRelax: Parallel-Path Relaxed Speculative Jacobi Decoding for Accelerating Auto-Regressive Text-to-Image Generation
summary: The growing need for high-resolution image generation in autoregressive text-to-image models has resulted in extended token sequences, significantly increasing computational costs and inference times. However, existing state-of-the-art methods for accelerating autoregressive text-to-image models rely on chain-structured draft token sequences, leading to inefficient draft token search and limited acceptance lengths. To address this, we propose parallel-path cross-relaxed speculative Jacobi decoding (\textbf{PathSpec}), a novel framework that enhances efficiency through a multi-sequence draft tree structure. Our parallel-path speculative Jacobi decoding (\textbf{PathExplore}) expands the token search space, achieving a higher speedup ratio without sacrificing image quality. Additionally, we introduce cross-path relaxed verification (\textbf{PathRelax}) that exploits semantic similarities across sequences to further boost token acceptance rates. Evaluated on the Parti-Prompts, MSCOCO2017, and T2ICompBench datasets, our method achieves a speedup ratio of 4.14 $\times$, 3.95$\times$, and 4.18$\times$, respectively. Remarkably, PathExplore, without any relaxed sampling, outperforms relaxed sampling methods in the speedup ratio, such as GSD and LANTERN. Moreover, PathRelax's relaxation mechanism can be seamlessly integrated with other relaxation techniques, enabling further acceleration and providing an efficient solution for real-time text-to-image generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Haodong-Lei-Ray/PathSpec.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PathSpec框架，通过并行路径交叉松弛推测性雅可比解码加速自回归文生图模型，在多个数据集上实现约4倍加速，且不牺牲图像质量。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率图像生成导致自回归文生图模型token序列变长，计算成本和推理时间显著增加。现有加速方法依赖链式草稿token序列，导致草稿搜索效率低、接受长度有限。
AI.method: 提出PathSpec框架，包含两个核心组件：1) PathExplore——并行路径推测性雅可比解码，通过多序列草稿树结构扩展token搜索空间；2) PathRelax——跨路径松弛验证，利用序列间语义相似性提升token接受率。
AI.result: 在Parti-Prompts、MSCOCO2017和T2ICompBench上分别实现4.14×、3.95×和4.18×的加速比。PathExplore无需松弛采样即优于GSD和LANTERN等松弛采样方法，PathRelax可与其他松弛技术无缝集成。
AI.conclusion: PathSpec通过并行路径结构和跨路径松弛机制显著提升自回归文生图模型推理效率，为实时文生图生成提供了高效解决方案。

title: Benchmarking Knowledge Editing using Logical Rules
comment: Accepted at the 24th International Semantic Web Conference 2025
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications that require access to up-to-date knowledge. However, retraining LLMs is computationally expensive. Therefore, knowledge editing techniques are crucial for maintaining current information and correcting erroneous assertions within pre-trained models. Current benchmarks for knowledge editing primarily focus on recalling edited facts, often neglecting their logical consequences. To address this limitation, we introduce a new benchmark designed to evaluate how knowledge editing methods handle the logical consequences of a single fact edit. Our benchmark extracts relevant logical rules from a knowledge graph for a given edit. Then, it generates multi-hop questions based on these rules to assess the impact on logical consequences. Our findings indicate that while existing knowledge editing approaches can accurately insert direct assertions into LLMs, they frequently fail to inject entailed knowledge. Specifically, experiments with popular methods like ROME and FT reveal a substantial performance gap, up to 24%, between evaluations on directly edited knowledge and on entailed knowledge. This highlights the critical need for semantics-aware evaluation frameworks in knowledge editing.

AI.tldr: 现有知识编辑方法能成功插入直接事实，但无法处理其逻辑推论（性能差距高达24%），本文提出基于知识图谱逻辑规则的多跳问答案例来评估这一缺陷。
AI.motivation: 当前知识编辑基准仅关注编辑后事实的回忆能力，忽略了其逻辑后果（即编辑一个事实后，模型能否正确推理出由此衍生的新知识），缺乏对语义级推理能力的评估。
AI.method: 从知识图谱中提取与编辑事实相关的逻辑规则，基于这些规则生成多跳问题，构建了一个评估知识编辑方法对逻辑后果处理能力的新基准。
AI.result: 现有方法（如ROME、FT）在直接编辑知识上表现良好，但在蕴含知识（逻辑推论）上性能下降高达24%，表明存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 知识编辑亟需语义感知的评估框架，仅插入直接断言是不够的，必须确保编辑后的模型能正确处理逻辑推论。

title: Learning What to Remember: Observability-Safe Memory Retention via Constrained Optimization for Long-Horizon Language Agents
summary: Long-horizon language agents accumulate observations, reasoning traces, and retrieved facts that exceed their finite context windows, making memory retention a fundamental resource-allocation problem. Existing memory systems improve management through heuristic scoring, retrieval optimization, or learned compression, but largely treat retention as a local decision problem and do not explicitly model its long-term consequences under realistic observability constraints. To fill this gap, we formulate memory retention as a constrained stochastic optimization problem with explicit budget feasibility, evidence utility, and delayed costs including miss penalties, reacquisition delays, and stale-information risk.
